# Proof of Loss Instructions

## Required Form

The signed proof of loss must be returned within 60 days after request unless the carrier grants a written extension.

The proof of loss must include the claim number, policy number, date of loss, and claimed amount.

## Evidence Rules

Every completed value on the proof of loss worksheet should cite a source document.

If evidence is missing or conflicting, leave the field for adjuster review instead of guessing.

## Additional Living Expense

Additional living expense requires hotel receipts, rental invoices, meal receipts, or other proof of incurred cost.

Do not issue additional living expense payment from a caller statement alone.
